verses.text: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
lines: Praise Yah!
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart,
in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.text: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
lines: Yahweh’s works are great,
pondered by all those who delight in them.

verses.text: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
lines: His work is honor and majesty.
His righteousness endures forever.

verses.text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
lines: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered.
Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

verses.text: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
lines: He has given food to those who fear him.
He always remembers his covenant.

verses.text: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
lines: He has shown his people the power of his works,
in giving them the heritage of the nations.

verses.text: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
lines: The works of his hands are truth and justice.
All his precepts are sure.

verses.text: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
lines: They are established forever and ever.
They are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.text: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
lines: He has sent redemption to his people.
He has ordained his covenant forever.
His name is holy and awesome!

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
lines: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.
All those who do his work have a good understanding.
His praise endures forever!
